acceptedAnswer.text: Xanthelasma itself is harmless, but it can be linked to cholesterol or lipid imbalances, so a medical evaluation is recommended.
A numbing cream is applied before treatment, so most patients feel only minimal discomfort.

mainEntity.name: Can xanthelasma come back after removal?

acceptedAnswer.text: Recurrence is possible, especially if lipid levels aren't managed. Following aftercare advice and managing cholesterol help reduce the risk.
Laser and radiofrequency methods aim for minimal scarring, though healing varies from person to person.
